events.title: 1 Year of HF News
events.description: HF News marked one year since Mix revived it in June 2025. A special section recounted how Cap lent a Warriors subforum to start the project, Omniscient's go-ahead, the HF Wiki sub-team formed after wiki permissions were granted on November 11, 2025, and thanks to past and present writers and Bytes donors. A giveaway with awards, Bytes, and crypto was teased.

events.title: MyBB Update 1.8.4
events.description: Omniscient finished manually reviewing and applying the relevant MyBB 1.8.4 changes and security patches to HF, which can't be updated in one click because it isn't a stock install.

events.title: SportsBook: World Cup Added
events.description: Following a member suggestion, World Cup betting was added to the Bytes Sportsbook.

events.title: Awards
events.description: SportsBook awarded to Weekend Offender. GFX Guru to bluewatertree. Flip Reaper to Motusora, Sift, and anua. King Decade to bοxxy and Unixroot™.

events.title: Statement on the US, suspend access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5
events.description: JoseMar shared the announcement that access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 was suspended after a US government directive, opening a discussion on frontier models, export controls, national security, and models being pulled from users.

events.title: I have returned after 10 years inactive.
events.description: Raijin came back after a decade away; older members welcomed him back and reminisced about old awards, groups, and reputation, with a dose of classic HF skepticism about returning accounts.

events.title: Macbook Air Installing Linux Mint
events.description: Omniscient documented trying to install Linux Mint on a 2020 Intel MacBook Air, running into T2 chip, keyboard, and trackpad issues; members suggested Arch, Manjaro, UTM, VirtualBox, and rEFInd.

events.title: AI models are not just getting dumber - Prompting is changing
events.description: Oh_Well argued that newer models feeling weaker is partly because prompting has changed: clear prompts now beat old-school mega prompts.

events.title: {Tutorial} Scrape the DarkWeb With Robin, A Legit DarkWeb Search Tool
events.description: Pr0m3th3us introduced Robin, an AI-assisted dark web search and scraping tool, covering local AI options, Docker, Tor requirements, and link liveness checks.

events.title: WLGen Browser Based Custom Wordlist Generator
events.description: Wake released WLGen, a lightweight, fully client-side custom wordlist generator that works on mobile and desktop with no installs.

events.title: HF BBCode Formatter Create Clean & Creative Forum Posts Faster
events.description: Wake released HF BBCode Formatter, with live preview, a formatting toolbar, templates, spoilers, code blocks, embeds, autosave, and one-click BBCode copying for HF posts.

events.title: Do Self-Help Products and Services Actually Work?
events.description: TheNaturalBoy used Robert Kiyosaki as a starting point to ask whether self-help books, courses, and gurus actually help or just recycle vague advice.
